international.title: British man recalls ‘despair’ over son’s death after fall from Cyprus window
international.summary: Joshua Foster tells of moment he ‘lost control’ of two-year-old when he fell from fourth storey of hotel A British father who was fined by the courts after his two-year-old son fell from a fourth-floor window during a family holiday in Cyprus has recalled his “despair” when the boy slipped from his grasp. Joshua Foster was handed a €3,000 (£2,500) penalty after he pleaded guilty to a charge of causing death through a reckless, rash or dangerous act. Prosecutors in Cyprus had refused to drop the case against him. Continue reading...
